import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,base64,json,sys
for page in [14,16,17,18]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-scale-to','1800','-png','-singlefile','inputs/sources/wavelet.pdf'],capture_output=True,timeout=25)
 assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 b=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode()
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(__import__('pathlib').Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),f'visuals/source-page-{page}.png','--base64'],input=b,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert w.returncode==0
 print(json.dumps({'page':page,'image':b}))
